# Software and reproducibility

The manuscript source is executable. The committed evaluation records are checked
by `scripts/check_evaluation.py`, and the repository README runs that checker and
the complete test suite while rendering.

## Core commands

```bash
make review
python scripts/compile_assay.py --help
python scripts/admit_amplicon_reads.py --help
python scripts/build_hba_family_map.py --help
python scripts/calibrate_amplicon_model.py --help
python scripts/genotype_amplicons.py --help
python scripts/audit_truth_regions.py --help
```

Each model result must retain the Git commit, assay profile and checksum, haplotype
catalogue checksum, molecule-admission configuration, calibration identity,
Cython-kernel identifier, sample/run/lot stratum, ambiguity/no-call reason and
output checksums.

Each WGS benchmark must retain the truth VCF/BED release, genome build, normalized
comparison command and exact target coverage. Each amplicon accuracy result must
retain the independent truth method appropriate to its event class and must keep
calibration controls separate from held-out evaluation samples.
